positive_terms: Disclosure of whether the undertaking has screened its assets and activities in order to identify actual and potential impacts, risks and opportunities in own operations and upstream and downstream value chain, and if so, methodologies, assumptions and tools used
资产与活动的筛查方法
说明主体是否已筛查其资产和活动，以识别自身运营及上下游价值链中的实际和潜在影响、风险与机遇，并说明所用方法、假设和工具。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
